description: List every image the business owns: its media library (uploads, photos copied from its old website at import, photos the owner attached in chat), its logo and every menu item photo. Each entry has its url, kind, source, where it is used, width/height in pixels and size in bytes (null when unknown), and tags a vision model read off the image: subject (dish, drink, interior, exterior, people, logo, menu), what it shows, whether it matches the dish it is labelled as, quality 1-5, dominant colors and alt text. Use these urls for any site or menu image; never use an outside image.

kind.description: Only photos or only logos; default any
